name: Climate System Science
summary: How the climate system works as a whole, what sets Earth's temperature, and the evidence for and causes of present-day climate change.

topics.name: Components of the climate system and their timescales
Global energy balance and the greenhouse effect
Latitudinal energy transport by atmosphere and ocean
The carbon cycle and greenhouse gases
Climate feedbacks: water vapour, lapse rate, ice-albedo and clouds
Natural variability: ENSO, NAO and volcanic and solar forcing
Observed climate change: the instrumental record
Sea-level rise: thermal expansion and ice melt
Climate models and future projections in outline
